name: PantryPal
one_liner: Snap a photo of your fridge to get three recipes tailored to what you have on hand.
problem: People often do not know what to cook with the ingredients currently in their fridge and end up letting food go to waste.
audience: Home cooks looking to quickly make meals from ingredients they already have.

features.name: Ingredient Detection from Photo
features.description: Users snap a photo of their open fridge with the camera button to automatically detect available ingredients.

features.name: Recipe Suggestions
features.description: Users view three recipes ranked by how many of their detected ingredients they use.

features.name: Missing Ingredients Shopping List
features.description: Users see a shopping list for the few missing ingredients required to make the suggested meals.
